detail: Partially torn Achilles found during surgery in May. Yahoo status O.
Rated around picks 100 to 110 in stash-friendly formats. Return expected between November and Christmas.
Experts fade him because of the Achilles. He went 6 USD in an expert mock.
Traded from Toronto to the Clippers in the Kawhi Leonard trade.
Usage expected to rise from 26.7% toward 30% as a top option with Garland once healthy.
Clippers have 13 back-to-backs, one of the lowest totals.
Yahoo value 16 USD against ESPN value 4 USD.
Wide swings in games played (18 to 77). Slow healer.
Needs a lot of the ball and is useless off the ball.
